journal:
Session 1 (2026-05-18). Regime: risk-on -- SPY and QQQ both above SMA20/50/200 (SPY 739.17 vs sma20 723.80/sma50 690.04/sma200 676.07), confirmed on the macro page (Fear & Greed 54 neutral, VIX 15.84, junk-bond spread reading extreme greed). Note for the record: the macro page's own figures (generated 2026-08-18, movers as of Aug 14 2026) are wall-clock, not session-dated -- this is the known, left-open institutions/macro lookahead gap (macro-snapshot-live-fetch-has-no-session-lookahead-boundary). I used it only for a qualitative regime read (rates/vol/sentiment direction), not for any price level or timing decision; every number that actually sized or triggered a trade came from `brief`'s bar-store watchlist, which is session-D-1-close and lookahead-safe.

Screened XLE (sector rotation, oil +17% 1M) and AAPL (52-week high, fully stacked SMAs, +11.1% 20d) -- both confirmed on 5d and 20d timeframes. Initiated XLE (25 sh, ~15% weight) and AAPL (6 sh, ~18% weight), leaving $6,718.66 cash and 6 of 8 position slots open. Stops written down before the fill: XLE 56.50 (below 20-SMA), AAPL 280.00 (below 20-SMA).

Spent most of the session on Institutions, per the assignment: re-testing the five items runs 9-11 flagged as fixed.

1. Derivative N/A row (institutions-derivative-row-lei-na-literal-not-excluded / institutions-unidentified-position-renders-as-literal-na-lei-na): HELD. QQQ's CME E-Mini NASDAQ 100 future now resolves to identifier TICKER:NQM6, issuer "CME E-Mini NASDAQ 100 Index Future", value -$12,012,436.80 -- no literal "N/A" anywhere. IVV's S&P 500 E-Mini future (no ticker on this one) falls through to ROW:247, issuer "S&P 500 E-Mini Index", value -$31,614,921.95, matching the figure from the prior run's report exactly. ARKK's OpenAI position resolves to NAME:OPENAI GROUP PBC SERIES C, $174,999,811.56 -- no LEI:N/A. Checked the uniqueness property directly: pulled /holdings and /changes for QQQ (102/104 rows), IVV (506/513 rows) and ARKK (46/51 rows) and grouped by identifier -- zero duplicate keys in any snapshot. The collision risk is closed, not just the display.

2. Filtered counts strip (institutions-counts-and-provenance-ignore-active-filters): HELD, on both sections. RENTECH (3,779 Changes rows) with the default "hide holds" filter reads "HOLD 0 of 6" and "Filters are hiding 6 of 3779 positions; 3773 shown." QQQ, which has zero hold rows, shows the tiles with no "of N" qualifier at all when nothing is hidden -- the inverse case the fix note called out explicitly. Forced IVV's Changes and Full Holdings sections both to zero rows by checking "only holdings I also own" (sandbox has no CUSIP bridge, so this hides everything) -- Changes read "Filters are hiding 513 of 513 positions; 0 shown" / "No rows match the current filters," and Full Holdings, once its own separate checkbox was ticked, read "Filter is hiding 506 of 506 holdings; 0 shown" with the provenance line above it still (correctly) describing the whole, unfiltered filing.

3. Absence-of-badge caveat (institutions-no-absence-of-badge-caveat): HELD. The line "Matched by CUSIP. A holding you own can still go unflagged -- only one of the three broker imports carries CUSIPs at all, so an unflagged row means no CUSIP match, not that you do not own it." sits directly under the "Only holdings I also own" checkbox in both the Changes and Full Holdings sections -- exactly where a reader would need it, not buried in a tooltip or footnote.

4. Changes % column sort (institutions-changes-pct-column-not-sortable): HELD. Sorted QQQ's Changes table by Shares % chg both directions. Descending: +10.16% down to -100.00%, then the three null (new) rows (Walmart, Ferrovial, the CME future) at the very end. Ascending: -100.00% up to +10.16%, and the same three null rows still at the end, not reinterpreted as zero and not scattered to the top. Defensible: a brand-new position genuinely has no percentage to rank, and parking it at the boundary in both directions reads as "not comparable" rather than falsely implying it is either the biggest mover or unchanged.

5. Weight column label (institutions-weight-column-unlabeled-vs-portfolio-weight-of-invested): PARTLY HELD -- this is new information, not in the prior report. The Changes table's header now reads "Weight in filing" with a title attribute ("Share of the total value disclosed in this filing," or the 13F-specific wording for 13F funds) -- confirmed via DOM inspection. But the Full Holdings table directly below it, same page, same fund, still has a bare "Weight" header with no title attribute at all (confirmed by inspecting <th> elements: only the Changes header carries `title`; the Full Holdings header does not, and its component, HoldingSortHeader, does not even accept a title prop). /portfolio's own column is "Weight (of invested)". A reader who scrolls straight to Full Holdings without ever reading the Changes section above it hits the exact ambiguity the fix was supposed to close.

409 InsufficientHistory: attempted honestly, not reached. /api/institutions/{key}/changes takes no query parameters at all (confirmed by reading the router), so there is no way for a caller to narrow the 6-filing candidate window the way `?period=` narrows /holdings. Hit /changes for all 11 catalog funds directly against the live backend -- all 11 return 200 with a real delta (one transient SCHD 503 cleared on retry, an EDGAR hiccup, not a defect). Cross-checked the 404 side for contrast: GET /institutions/QQQ/holdings?period=1990-01-01 returns 404 PeriodNotFound naming the periods actually on file, confirming it's a genuinely different state from 409 (never observed). Given every catalog fund has 2+ periods and the endpoint has no caller-facing lever to shrink the window, this is unreachable through the API as currently built -- consistent with what runs 9-11 already concluded, and I did not fabricate a workaround.

Session 2 (2026-05-19). Regime unchanged, risk-on. XLE +1.9% 1d, tracking the sector-rotation thesis (close 60.58, above SMA20 57.81 and now nearly re-crossed SMA50 58.16). AAPL pulled back -0.80% 1d but is still above its 20-SMA (282.79) -- not an invalidation. No new screen cleared the two-timeframe bar (SOXX/NVDA remain extended and pulling back short-term; TSLA -7.9% 5d, below its own 20-SMA, no interest). Held, no orders this session -- 6 of 8 slots still open, ,718.66 cash. Used the session to check Portfolio, Wash Sales and Tax for regressions given the shared styles.css/parse.py touch. Portfolio: cash ($6,718.66), settled cash and total equity ($10,126.59) all render correctly and the header explicitly flags 'priced at closes ranging 2026-08-14 -> 2026-08-18 -- the market-value and unrealized totals below mix 2 different pricing dates' when AAPL and XLE happen to be priced off different stale closes -- exactly the partial/mixed-staleness labelling this persona has asked for, still holding. Wash Sales empty state and Tax page (correctly defaulting to 2026, correctly distinguishing '3 transactions, 0 disposals' from an empty ledger) both read as designed, no regressions found.

Session 3 (2026-05-20). Regime unchanged, risk-on, though breadth is thinning slightly -- SPY and QQQ both -0.6% 1d, GLD continuing to weaken (-4.95% 5d, -4.21% 20d, below both its 20- and 50-SMA), which if anything supports risk-on since gold selling off alongside equities holding their trend is a real-asset rotation signal, not a flight to safety. XLE and AAPL both continue in-thesis (XLE close 61.29, +1.17% 1d, +6.46% 5d; AAPL close 298.97, +0.38% 1d, +1.41% 5d) -- no invalidation on either stop. No new name cleared the two-timeframe screen (SOXX still pulling back over 5d despite a strong 20d trend; TSLA -6.8% 5d and below its own 20-SMA). Held again, no orders. 6 of 8 slots open, $6,718.66 cash.

Spot-checked Rules and Backtest for regressions given the shared styles.css touch -- both render cleanly, rule catalog descriptions intact, backtest's four-study framing (drawdown profile / event study / scan / reverse conditioning) unchanged and still honest about sample size and baselines in the page copy itself. No new findings.

Session 4 (2026-05-21). Regime still risk-on and broadening -- SPY +1.02% 1d, QQQ +1.66% 1d, both breaking the prior two sessions' chop. Added QQQ (3 sh, ~21% weight) for index-level exposure separate from the AAPL single-name bet, confirmed on 1d and 20d (close 713.15, +8.86% 20d, above both SMA20 689.07 and SMA50 637.56); the 5d read was flat-to-slightly-negative but that reads as noise inside an intact 20d trend, not a contradiction. XLE pulled back -2.43% 1d (close 59.80 -> after today's fill context) but remains above its stop (56.50) and above SMA20 (58.25); no invalidation yet, watching. Book after fill: AAPL 18.2%, QQQ 21.3%, XLE 14.7%, cash $4,590.64, 3 of 8 slots used.

Checked /report/QQQ and /thesis/XLE for regressions. Report: verified-prose framing intact, every numeral traced to a source citation (store/QQQ, decision_table/QQQ etc.), drawdown and rule-evidence sections both honest about small sample sizes and the no-correction caveat on "largest edge" rule selection -- no regression. Thesis: empty-ledger state for XLE renders correctly (0 trials, holdout not yet established, correct warning that running the loop writes permanently and burns the one holdout look) -- did not actually run a thesis loop this session, since doing so would permanently consume this sandbox ticker's holdout for no in-character reason this session. No new findings on either page.

Session 5 (2026-05-22), final session of the week. Regime unchanged, risk-on but momentum flattening -- SPY and QQQ both roughly flat 1d (+0.20%/+0.19%), 5d slightly negative on both (-0.73%), 20d still solidly positive. Nothing invalidated: XLE (-1.12% 1d, close 59.13, still above SMA20 58.35 and above its 56.50 stop by a wide margin), AAPL (+0.91% 1d, close 304.99, a fresh high) and QQQ (+0.19% 1d, close 714.51, above SMA20 692.23) all intact. No new name cleared the two-timeframe screen and nothing already held needed trimming. Held, no orders -- book unchanged at 3 of 8 slots, $4,590.64 cash, equity roughly flat to the week's opening $10,000.

No position ever traded into an unrealized loss this week (XLE's low-water mark was still a small gain against its 59.16 cost), so a wash-sale scenario -- a loss sale followed by a replacement purchase inside 30 days -- never became reachable in character. Forcing a sale at a loss purely to manufacture one would have been trading out of character against this week's actual price action, which the assignment explicitly says is worse than not having the scenario; not attempted. Confirmed via Activity that all 4 transactions (1 deposit, 3 buys) reconcile exactly against the three fills recorded in orders.jsonl, with provenance import IDs shown per row.

Summary for the week: three positions initiated (XLE, AAPL, QQQ), zero rejections, zero sales, ending equity essentially flat to inception. The week's actual work was the Institutions re-test (see session 1's journal and findings) and a page-by-page regression sweep (Portfolio, Wash Sales, Tax, Rules, Backtest, Report, Thesis, Activity) given that parse.py, Institutions.tsx and styles.css were the last things touched and the latter two are shared across the app -- no regressions found on any page outside Institutions itself.
